# Samsara Ventures

> Samsara Ventures is a boutique, senior-led advisory firm based in New York. It supports private equity firms, portfolio companies and corporate leaders with M&A transactions, private equity value creation, business transformation and growth strategy across North America.

## Services
- [Transaction Advisory](https://www.thesamsaraventures.com/services/transaction-advisory/): operational and IT due diligence, M&A integration, carve-outs and separations, transition service agreements, Day 1 and Day 100 readiness, synergy identification and execution
- [Value Creation & Transformation](https://www.thesamsaraventures.com/services/value-creation/): private equity value creation planning, execution PMO leadership, operating model transformation, cost optimization, technology and business transformation, performance improvement
- [Growth & Commercial Strategy](https://www.thesamsaraventures.com/services/growth-strategy/): go-to-market strategy and execution, product commercialization (including AI-enabled products), growth planning, commercial operating models, sales enablement

## Who it serves
- Private equity firms and their portfolio companies
- Corporate development and M&A executives
- C-suite leaders navigating complex transformations

## About
- [About](https://www.thesamsaraventures.com/about/): founded in 2025 by Arjun Dhingra, Founder & Managing Partner, previously at PwC (M&A advisory), EY-Parthenon (transaction strategy and execution) and Deloitte Consulting
- [Experience](https://www.thesamsaraventures.com/experience/): anonymized examples of integration, separation, value creation and go-to-market work
